protocol_metadata.about: Ink Bridge is the canonical bridge for Ink, an Optimistic Rollup L2 (chain ID 57073) built on the OP Stack by Kraken (Payward Inc). Users deposit ETH and ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum L1 via the L1StandardBridge and OptimismPortal2 contracts, receiving equivalent representations on Ink L2 after a sequencer inclusion. Withdrawals require initiating on L2, waiting for a 3.5-day fraud-proof challenge period, then finalizing on L1 via OptimismPortal2. Upgrades are controlled by a shared Superchain governance structure: a 2/2 multisig (Optimism Foundation 5/7 Safe + Optimism Security Council 10/13 Safe) can upgrade all bridge contracts with no timelock delay, placing the system at OP Stack Stage 1.
